evidence_items.explanation: The study reports an increasing detector-labeled AI share in FineWeb-filtered Common Crawl text, reaching 31.1% in August 2026. Its 800-model experiments show possible benefits and harms, but do not track recursive ancestry across successive deployed model generations.

The paper finds different outcomes when synthetic data replace earlier data versus accumulate alongside retained data. This challenges inevitability, but experimental mitigation does not establish what happened in undisclosed production training corpora.
